question: Within a radius of 90 kilometers, where can I locate fast food restaurant on the journey from J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC to Silk Hope Ruritan Club, Siler City, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fayetteville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Silk Hope Ruritan Club%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Siler City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 90000));
